descriptionHtml:
要人拍板 D2 · P0 · Preston

裸数字给加单位（体温 38→38°C、60→60°F）算不算「编造单位」？（GK11）

同一个问题的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-23/S15

思路 / Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S16 「保持存的体温单位：°C（养老院和医院）、°F（医院）、不带单位的数字（医院）」 Stored temperature unit is kept: °C (NH and Hospital), °F (Hospital), bare number (Hospital)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 Temperatures are quoted in the stored unit (°C stays °C, °F stays °F).（UAT TC-15；TFA-92593 AC 8）
  • U4 Answers are grounded only in that patient's data: no cross-patient bleed, no invented information, no outside data; per 3.4 no guessed units on ambiguous values and no narration of documentation stat …（UAT TC-15；TFA-92593 AC 3；UAT 3.4）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Vitals temp stored as '38.1 °C' (main, NH); variants: Hospital '38.1 °C', Hospital '100.6 °F', Hospital bare 37.9 / 100.4 / 60

When Type "What was the temperature?"

Then Answer quotes the stored value in the stored unit, never converted; a bare number is not converted

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：°C entries: mustInclude '38.1' and °C/celsius, mustNotInclude °F/100.6/Fahrenheit. °F entry: mustInclude '100.6', mustNotInclude '38.1'/°C/celsius. Bare entries: no conversion in the answer; the context check pins what fmtTemp adds (37.9 → '37.9°C', 100.4 → '100.4°F', 60 → bare) — whether that added unit is allowed is Q4, recorded, not judged

在哪跑：dev 单元 U41；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S16 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-15.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；要拍板的人：Preston。

问题分类：要人拍板（Preston） · 环境 dev · 票 TFA-92593 ready for qa

病历里存的体温只有数字 60，Ask AI 回答「60°F」，加了病历里没有的单位，虽然也指出这个数不合理。

Asked about a stored bare temperature of 60, Ask AI answers '60°F', adding a unit the chart never had, although it also flags the value as implausible.

依据：Allure 488ca496. Ledger #41 U41: 'Fail → needs Preston (cluster U)'. Dev report §3 row 2 (GK11): does a clinically unambiguous bare temperature count as a guessed unit? 37.9→°C and 100.4→°F were accepted. TFA-92593 AC: temperatures are quoted in the stored unit.

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。
